title: SkillZone — Online Learning Platform API
description: Online learning API for managing educational centers, branches, courses, instructors, and student interactions. Features include role-based access control, JWT authentication, Google OAuth 2.0, and comprehensive course management with progress tracking, quizzes, and PDF certificate generation.
shortDesc: Online learning platform API with RBAC, JWT, and OAuth 2.0

title: E-commerce API
description: A full-featured e-commerce backend API built with Node.js and Express. Implements JWT authentication, role-based access control, product management, shopping cart, order processing, and payment integration.
shortDesc: Full e-commerce backend with auth, products, cart, and orders
features: Product CRUD with categories and search

title: Workflow Automation Platform
description: A workflow automation platform built with TypeScript, enabling users to create, manage, and execute automated workflows. Features include visual workflow builder, scheduled tasks, webhook triggers, and integrations with common services.
shortDesc: Automate workflows with a visual builder and scheduled tasks

title: SaaS Multitenant API
description: A multitenant SaaS backend architecture built with Node.js and Express. Supports tenant isolation, shared database with tenant-scoped queries, subscription management, and billing integration.
shortDesc: Multitenant SaaS backend with tenant isolation and billing

title: Microservices Project
description: A microservices-based architecture demonstrating service decomposition, API gateway pattern, inter-service communication via message queues, service discovery, and containerized deployment with Docker.
shortDesc: Microservices demo with API gateway and message queues

title: Event Booking API
description: A RESTful API for event management and ticket booking. Supports creating events with capacity limits, booking tickets, waiting list management, and event analytics.
shortDesc: Event management and ticket booking API

title: Fitness Tracker API
description: A RESTful API for logging workouts, tracking progress, and generating fitness summaries. Users can create workout routines, log exercises, view progress over time, and get personalized fitness insights.
shortDesc: Log workouts, track progress, get fitness summaries

title: URL Shortener API
description: A URL shortening service that converts long URLs into short, shareable links. Supports custom aliases, click tracking, expiration dates, and analytics.
shortDesc: Shorten URLs with custom aliases and click tracking

title: Notes API
description: A CRUD API for managing notes with rich text, tags, categories, and full-text search. Supports user authentication, note sharing, and markdown rendering.
shortDesc: CRUD notes with tags, search, and markdown

title: Chatbot API
description: A rule-based chatbot API that processes user messages and returns intelligent responses. Supports multiple conversation flows, context awareness, and easy extensibility for custom rules.
